children.name: Ephedra
children.description: Ephedra — a genus of gnetopsidas.

children.name: Ephedra × arenicola
children.description: The native range of this species is Arizona. It is a subshrub and grows primarily in the subtropical biome.

children.name: Ephedra × eleutherolepis
children.description: The native range of this species is C. Asia. It is a subshrub and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Ephedra alata
children.description: Ephedra alata is a species of Ephedra.

children.name: Ephedra altissima
children.description: Ephedra altissima is a species of Ephedra that is native to the western Sahara (Morocco, Algeria, Tunisia, Libya, Chad, Mauritania), and also to the Canary Islands.

children.name: Ephedra americana
children.description: The native range of this species is Ecuador to NW. Argentina. It is a subshrub and grows primarily in the subtropical biome.

children.name: Ephedra antisyphilitica
children.description: Ephedra antisyphilitica is a plant species native to the southern Great Plains of the United States (Oklahoma, New Mexico, Texas), and also to northeastern Mexico (Nuevo León, Coahuila, San Luis Potosí).

children.name: Ephedra aphylla
children.description: The native range of this species is E. Medit. to Arabian Pen.. It is a subshrub or shrub and grows primarily in the desert or dry shrubland biome.

children.name: Ephedra aspera
children.description: Ephedra aspera is a species of Ephedra known by the common names rough jointfir, boundary ephedra, and pitamoreal.

children.name: Ephedra aurantiaca
children.description: The native range of this species is Transcaucasus to C. Asia. It is a subshrub and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Ephedra aurea
children.description: The native range of this species is Sicilia. It grows primarily in the subtropical biome.
children.authorship: Brullo, C.Brullo, Cambria, Ilardi, Siracusa & Giusso

children.name: Ephedra boelckei
children.description: The native range of this species is NW. Argentina. It grows primarily in the subtropical biome.

children.name: Ephedra botschantzevii
children.description: The native range of this species is S. Siberia to C. Asia. It is a shrub and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Ephedra breana
children.description: Ephedra breana (frutilla de campo, pingo-pingo) is a species of Ephedra growing from northwest Argentina through to Chile and Bolivia.

children.name: Ephedra brevifoliata
children.description: The native range of this species is Iran. It grows primarily in the subtropical biome.

children.name: Ephedra californica
children.description: Ephedra californica is a species of Ephedra, known by the common names California jointfir, California ephedra, desert tea, Mormon tea, and cañatillo.

children.name: Ephedra chengiae
children.description: The native range of this species is Tibet. It grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Ephedra chilensis
children.description: Ephedra chilensis, also known as pingo-pingo, is a species of plant in the division Gnetophyta.

children.name: Ephedra ciliata
children.description: The native range of this species is N. Africa to C. Asia and NW. India. It is a scrambling shrub and grows primarily in the desert or dry shrubland biome.

children.name: Ephedra compacta
children.description: The native range of this species is Mexico. It is a subshrub and grows primarily in the desert or dry shrubland biome.

children.name: Ephedra coryi
children.description: Ephedra coryi, also known as Cory's joint-fir, is a rare, reed-like gymnosperm native to sandy, semi-arid areas of the North American South and Southwest.

children.name: Ephedra cutleri
children.description: Ephedra cutleri, the Navajo ephedra or Cutler's jointfir, is a species of Ephedra that is native to the Southwestern United States (Arizona, New Mexico, Utah, Colorado, Nevada, Wyoming).

children.name: Ephedra dahurica
children.description: The native range of this species is Siberia to Mongolia. It is a subshrub and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Ephedra dawuensis
children.description: The native range of this species is China (Sichuan). It is a subshrub and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Ephedra distachya
children.description: Ephedra distachya is a shrub in the family Ephedraceae that stands about 25 cm to 50 cm high.

children.name: Ephedra equisetina
children.description: The native range of this species is Caucasus to S. Russian Far East. It is a shrub and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Ephedra fasciculata
children.description: Ephedra fasciculata is a species of plant in the Ephedraceae family.

children.name: Ephedra fedtschenkoae
children.description: The native range of this species is C. Asia to SW. Siberia and Mongolia. It is a shrub or tree and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Ephedra foeminea
children.description: The native range of this species is SE. Europe to NE. Trop. Africa. It is a scrambling shrub and grows primarily in the subtropical biome.

children.name: Ephedra fragilis
children.description: Ephedra fragilis, commonly named the joint pine, is a species of Ephedra from the western Mediterranean region of southern Europe (Italy, Spain, and Portugal) and Northern Africa, and from Madeira and the Canary Islands in the Atlantic.

children.name: Ephedra frustillata
children.description: Ephedra frustillata, the Patagonian ephedra, is a plant species in the genus Ephedra.

children.name: Ephedra funerea
children.description: Ephedra funerea is a species of Ephedra, known by the common name Death Valley jointfir, Death Valley ephedra, or Mormon Tea.

children.name: Ephedra gerardiana
children.description: Ephedra gerardiana (Gerard's jointfir, 山岭麻黄 shan ling ma huang) is a species of Ephedra, endemic to the mountains of Afghanistan, Bhutan, northern India, Nepal, Pakistan, Sikkim, Tajikistan, and Tibet.

children.name: Ephedra glauca
children.description: The native range of this species is Iran to Mongolia and Pakistan. It is a subshrub and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Ephedra gracilis
children.description: The native range of this species is Chile (Atacama, Coqimbo). It is a subshrub or shrub and grows primarily in the desert or dry shrubland biome.

children.name: Ephedra holoptera
children.description: The native range of this species is Iran (Khorasan). It grows primarily in the subtropical biome.

children.name: Ephedra intermedia
children.description: Ephedra intermedia, with the Chinese common name of Zhong Ma Huang, is a species of Ephedra that is native to Siberia, Central Asia, Iran, Afghanistan, Pakistan, the western Himalayas, Tibet, Mongolia, and China.

children.name: Ephedra karumanchiana
children.description: The native range of this species is NW. India. It grows primarily in the desert or dry shrubland biome.

children.name: Ephedra laristanica
children.description: The native range of this species is Iran. It grows primarily in the subtropical biome.

children.name: Ephedra likiangensis
children.description: The native range of this species is E. Tibet to China (W. Sichuan, NW. Yunnan, W. Guizhou). It is a subshrub and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Ephedra lomatolepis
children.description: The native range of this species is Kazakhstan to SW. Siberia and SW. Mongolia. It is a subshrub and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Ephedra milleri
children.description: The native range of this species is Arabian Pen.. It is a subshrub or shrub and grows primarily in the desert or dry shrubland biome.

children.name: Ephedra minuta
children.description: The native range of this species is C. Asia to Qinghai and China (Sichuan). It is a subshrub and grows primarily in the subalpine or subarctic biome.

children.name: Ephedra monosperma
children.description: Ephedra monosperma, also called Ephedra minima or dan zi ma huang (in Chinese), is small shrub in the family of Ephedraceae.

children.name: Ephedra multiflora
children.description: The native range of this species is Chile (Antofagasta), Argentina (Catamarca to Neuquén). It is a shrub and grows primarily in the subtropical biome.

children.name: Ephedra nebrodensis
children.description: The native range of this species is Canary Is., Medit. to Mauritania. It is a shrub and grows primarily in the subtropical biome.

children.name: Ephedra nevadensis
children.description: Ephedra nevadensis, commonly known as Nevada ephedra, gray ephedra, Mormon tea and Nevada jointfir, is a species of gymnosperm native to dry areas of western North America.

children.name: Ephedra nutans
children.description: The native range of this species is Xinjiang. It grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Ephedra ochreata
children.description: The native range of this species is Argentina (Catamarca to Santa Cruz). It is a subshrub or shrub and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Ephedra oxyphylla
children.description: The native range of this species is E. Afghanistan. It grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Ephedra pachyclada
children.description: The native range of this species is Sinai to Pakistan. It is a subshrub or shrub and grows primarily in the subtropical biome.

children.name: Ephedra pedunculata
children.description: The native range of this species is SW. Texas to NE. Mexico. It is a climbing shrub and grows primarily in the desert or dry shrubland biome.

children.name: Ephedra pentandra
children.description: The native range of this species is Iran. It grows primarily in the subtropical biome.

children.name: Ephedra procera
children.description: The native range of this species is Balkan Pen. to W. Himalaya. It is a shrub and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Ephedra przewalskii
children.description: Ephedra przewalskii is a species of Ephedra that is native to Central Asia, Mongolia, Pakistan, and parts of China (Gansu, Inner Mongolia, Ningxia, Qinghai, and Tibet).

children.name: Ephedra pseudodistachya
children.description: The native range of this species is Siberia to Mongolia. It is a shrub and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Ephedra regeliana
children.description: The native range of this species is C. Asia to SW. Siberia and W. Himalaya. It is a subshrub and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Ephedra rhytidosperma
children.description: The native range of this species is Mongolia to N. China. It is a subshrub and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Ephedra rituensis
children.description: The native range of this species is W. China. It is a subshrub and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Ephedra rupestris
children.description: The native range of this species is Ecuador to NW. Argentina. It grows primarily in the subtropical biome.

children.name: Ephedra sarcocarpa
children.description: The native range of this species is S. Afghanistan to SW. Pakistan. It grows primarily in the subtropical biome.

children.name: Ephedra saxatilis
children.description: The native range of this species is Nepal to China (N. Yunnan). It is a subshrub or shrub and grows primarily in the subtropical biome.

children.name: Ephedra sinica
children.description: Ephedra sinica (also known as Chinese ephedra or ma huang) is a species of Ephedra in the plant family Ephedraceae.

children.name: Ephedra somalensis
children.description: The native range of this species is Eritrea to N. Somalia. It is a subshrub or shrub and grows primarily in the desert or dry shrubland biome.

children.name: Ephedra stipitata
children.description: The native range of this species is W. Himalaya. It grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Ephedra strobilacea
children.description: Ephedra strobilacea is a species of Ephedra that is native to Iran and Central Asia (Afghanistan, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan, Uzbekistan).

children.name: Ephedra strongylensis
children.description: The native range of this species is Sicilia (Aeolian Is.). It is a subshrub or shrub and grows primarily in the subtropical biome.
children.authorship: Brullo, C.Brullo, Cambria, Ilardi, Siracusa, Miniss. & Giuss

children.name: Ephedra tilhoana
children.description: The native range of this species is Chad (Tibesti Mts.). It is a subshrub or shrub and grows primarily in the desert or dry shrubland biome.

children.name: Ephedra torreyana
children.description: Ephedra torreyana, with common names Torrey's jointfir or Torrey's Mormon tea, is a species of Ephedra that is native to the deserts and scrublands of the Southwestern United States (Nevada, Utah, Colorado, Arizona, New Mexico, Texas) and to the State of Chihuahua and northern Mexico.

children.name: Ephedra transitoria
children.description: The native range of this species is Syria to Arabian Pen.. It is a subshrub and grows primarily in the desert or dry shrubland biome.

children.name: Ephedra triandra
children.description: The native range of this species is Bolivia to Argentina. It is a shrub and grows primarily in the subtropical biome.

children.name: Ephedra trifurca
children.description: Ephedra trifurca is a species of Ephedra known by the common names longleaf jointfir and Mexican tea.

children.name: Ephedra trifurcata
children.description: The native range of this species is Chile (Valparaíso). It is a shrub and grows primarily in the subtropical biome.

children.name: Ephedra tweedieana
children.description: The native range of this species is S. Brazil to NE. Argentina. It grows primarily in the subtropical biome.

children.name: Ephedra viridis
children.description: Ephedra viridis, known by the common names green Mormon tea, Brigham tea, green ephedra, and Indian tea, is a species of Ephedra.

children.name: Ephedra vvedenskyi
children.description: The native range of this species is E. Transcaucasus to S. Turkmenistan. It is a subshrub and grows primarily in the temperate biome.
